senses.gloss: छस् tad. affix ईय added to the word भवत् in the general शैषिक senses, e. g. भवदीयः; cf P. IV.2.115. The mute letter स् has been attached to the affix छस् So that the base भवत् before it could be termed pada (cf. सिति च P, I.4.16) and as a result have the consonant त् chang- ed into द् by P. VIII.2.39.
